standard_prerequisites.name: Fibred equivalence transfers fibredness
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces to the case where both categories are fibred and F, G preserve strongly cartesian morphisms.

standard_prerequisites.name: Mor presheaf identification along a 1-morphism
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the Mor presheaves of S_1 with those of F(x), F(y), so the sheaf condition transfers.

core_obligations: Reduce to both categories fibred via the fibred-equivalence lemma; note F and G are then 1-morphisms of fibred categories.
Prove the Mor-sheaf condition transfers: the presheaves Mor_{S_1}(x,y) and Mor_{S_1}(F(x),F(y)) are identified, hence one is a sheaf iff the other is.

Prove descent effectiveness transfers: pull a descent datum (X_i, varphi_{ii'}) of S_2 back through G to S_1, effectuate it there, push the effectuating object forward through F and show the resulting datum is isomorphic to the original one using the equivalence constraints i and j.
proof_roadmap: Transfer the three stack conditions across the equivalence one at a time, using that F and G preserve strongly cartesian morphisms.
difficulty_reason: Three distinct conditions (fibredness, Mor sheaves, effective descent) each need a separate transfer argument, with the descent step requiring a pull-effectuate-push round trip through both functors.
